stories.title: Citizen Portal Uses AI to Make Local Government Easier to Follow
stories.summary: Ancestry.com co-founder Paul Allen's Citizen Portal has cataloged over 2 million government meetings and is on pace to transcribe 625,000 hours of proceedings this year. The AI platform turns endless city council and school board sessions into searchable summaries linked straight to the source.
stories.extended_summary: Two million meetings and counting — that's how much local government Citizen Portal has already cataloged, with 625,000 hours of proceedings set to be transcribed in 2026 alone. Founder Paul Allen, an Ancestry.com co-founder, and GM Thomas Dyches showed how the platform turns marathon city council and school board sessions into AI summaries that link back to the original records. Community editors can now cover public meetings they'd never have time to sit through, and residents can search transcripts for exactly what their government said.
